title: Seat an aluminium housing on a fixture's datum stops, then lock both toggle clamps
instruction: Set the casting hard into the fixture's corner stops, then close both hold-down clamps over it.
context: Setting a part on a fixture's stops and clamping it is a task of three O*NET occupations: machinists (51-4041.00, 288,300 US jobs in 2025) "align and secure holding fixtures, cutting tools, attachments, accessories, or materials onto machines"; CNC tool operators (51-9161.00, 170,000) "mount, install, align, and secure tools, attachments, fixtures, and workpieces on machines"; welders, cutters, solderers and brazers (51-4121.06, 437,700) "position items in fixtures, jigs, or vises": 896,000 jobs. Here: an aluminium housing in a machining fixture. The hard parts, in order: (1) carry it over the clamp bases, set it down; (2) push it square into both stops, within 1.0 mm at both ends of each, not turning it; (3) clamp only then: each pad presses 25 N, so a part clamped off a stop is held there, unseated; (4) push each handle past over-centre, or it springs back open; (5) the clamps stand on two sides, each pushed from its outer side.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; the table top is z = 0. x points forward from the line through the two arm bases, y to the left of the midpoint between them, z up; arm bases at y +30.5 cm and -30.5 cm. (1) Fixture plate, fixed, steel: x 220 to 380 mm, y -160 to +160 mm, 12 mm thick. On it, fixed steel datum stops, 12 mm tall: S1 across the far side, x 330 to 345 mm, y -45 to +45 mm; S2 along the right side, x 280 to 320 mm, y -60 to -50 mm. (2) Splash guard, fixed, steel, 8 mm thick, 400 mm wide, 140 mm tall: x 395 to 403 mm, y -200 to +200 mm. (3) Two vertical hold-down toggle clamps, pad reach close to DESTACO catalogue arm lengths (C1 like a 207-U, 54 mm arm; C2 like a 210-U, 92 mm arm), fixed bases (steel foot 32 x 34 x 4 mm on the plate, post 28 x 34 mm up to 40 mm above the table), each with one blue lever that turns about a pivot 54 mm above the table: a 12 mm wide arm bar 8 mm thick with a red 12 x 12 x 8 mm pad under its end, and a handle bar 12 mm wide, 8 mm thick, lying 12 mm above the arm when shut, with a black grip 16 mm wide and 14 mm thick over its last 45 mm. C1 on the near side: pivot x 236 mm, y -25 mm; arm 62 mm long toward +x, pad centre 52 mm from the pivot (x 288 mm); handle 70 mm. C2 on the left side: pivot x 300 mm, y +125 mm; arm 99 mm long toward -y, pad centre 91 mm from the pivot (y +34 mm); handle 90 mm. Both start open: the lever stands 30 degrees back past vertical, away from the casting, on its stop. Shut: arm horizontal, pad underside 42 mm above the table (on the casting's top), handle flat. The handle resists with about 1.5 N at its grip up to 55 degrees from vertical (over-centre); short of it, let go, it springs back open; past it the clamp shuts itself and its pad presses the casting with 25 N (a spindle set for a light press), and it stays shut until its grip is lifted with about 27 N (C1) or 34 N (C2); a lever shut on nothing stops 15 degrees past flat. (4) Staging block, fixed, white HDPE, 100 (x) x 150 (y) x 20 mm: x 210 to 310 mm, y +170 to +320 mm. (5) Casting, loose: an aluminium housing, 60 (x) x 100 (y) x 30 mm tall, made as a 6061 aluminium block of that size pocketed from below to 5 mm walls and a 5 mm top (0.18 kg at 2.70 g/cm3), friction about 0.3, grey, lying right way up on the block, its centre at x 260 mm, y +245 mm, its 100 mm side along y. Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: End state, read at the last step from the casting's pose, both levers' hinge angles and both grippers; a missing or non-finite reading scores 0. Seated: the casting lies flat on the plate (tilt at most 1 degree, lowest corner within 1.5 mm of the plate's top), its far face within 1.0 mm of S1 (gap or overlap) at both ends of S1's 90 mm face (40 mm either side of its centre) and its right face within 1.0 mm of S2 at both ends of S2's 40 mm face (x 285 and 315 mm); a stop point the face does not cover (3 mm in from its edges) counts as a miss. Shut: a handle within 8 degrees of flat or past it. Locked: shut, with the centre of the pad's underside between 1.5 mm into the casting's top face and 0.5 mm above it, and at least 4 mm inside the face's edges (the pad then presses it with 25 N). A clamp shut on nothing is not locked. Hands off: on every step of the last 1 s both grippers' finger zones are 30 mm or more from the casting and from both clamps, and over that 1 s the casting moves at most 1 mm and turns at most 1 degree and neither handle turns over 2 degrees. Score 0 if not hands off or if not seated (this includes a casting clamped off its stops: its pads hold it there). Otherwise: 1.0 both clamps locked; 0.5 one locked; 0.25 none locked. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0. Success: 1.0 held for 1 s. Real trial, per condition: seated, a 1.0 mm feeler gauge at each end of each stop and a level on the casting's top; locked (each clamp), the handle flat to an 8 degree angle gauge, a 0.5 mm feeler gauge does not slide under the pad, and a 10 N lift on a spring scale at the grip leaves it shut; for 1.0 also a proof test with both clamps locked: a 20 N pull on a spring scale, straight up and then sideways away from the stops, does not move the casting on a dial indicator; hands off, a 30 mm spacer against each hand, the dial indicator (1 mm) and 30 fps video of the last 1 s.
reset_notes: Open both clamps (levers back on their stops), clear the plate and wipe chips off the stops, and lay the casting right way up on the staging block with its centre at x 260 mm, y +245 mm and its 100 mm side along y. Nothing is consumed; check each pad's press (25 N, set by the spindle) once a session and change the pads every few hundred closings.
fidelity: Clamp arm reach from DESTACO 207-U and 210-U catalogue arms (54, 92 mm; pads 52, 91 mm from the pivot); other sizes are our own. Each clamp is one lever on a hinge; its toggle links are not modelled. Declared rule: a stiff joint drive pulls the lever open (1.5 N at the grip) until 55 degrees from vertical, then toward 40 degrees past flat, so a pad shut on the casting presses it with 25 N (est). Casting: a solid box collider with the pocketed block's 0.18 kg; friction 0.3 (est).
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0; demo: 1.0; one arm (left only): 0.5; one arm (right only): 0.0
